title: Formal and Substantive Conditions for Inter-Authority Dispute Jurisdiction
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Jurisdiction over inter-authority disputes
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) has jurisdiction to give an opinion on disputes arising between ministries or public authorities. FAIL if the note does not state that the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) has jurisdiction over disputes arising between ministries or public authorities.

criteria.title: Binding opinion
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the opinion of the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) in these disputes is binding on both parties. FAIL if the note does not state that the opinion of the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) in these disputes is binding on both parties.

criteria.title: Formal and substantive conditions
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the General Assembly's (الجمعية العمومية) exercise of its jurisdiction requires that the dispute fulfils its formal and substantive conditions (شرائطه الشكلية والموضوعية). FAIL if the note does not state that the exercise of the General Assembly's jurisdiction requires that the dispute fulfils its formal and substantive conditions (شرائطه الشكلية والموضوعية).

criteria.title: Supporting documents required
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the dispute must be supported by the documents necessary for its examination and determination. FAIL if the note does not state that the dispute must be supported by the documents necessary for its examination and determination.

criteria.title: Authority to prepare dispute
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) has the authority to prepare the dispute so that it is fit for determination before issuing its opinion. FAIL if the note does not state that the General Assembly (الجمعية العمومية) has the authority to prepare the dispute so that it is fit for determination before issuing its opinion.

review.notes: Verified C-001 through C-005 against Article 66(d) of State Council Law No. 47 of 1972 and General Assembly jurisprudence on formal/substantive admissibility conditions, supporting documentation, and dispute preparation.
